Author: platis
Name: XIV.fm
Punchline: Share what you are listening to in Final Fantasy XIV.
Description: XIV.fm displays Last.fm listening presence on cards anchored above player nameplates.
Changelog:
- Refines the compact card to 222×58 with a 42×42 conditional cover area.
- Removes the red XIV.fm heading and separator.
- Adds a visually bold track title and leaves the cover area empty when artwork is unavailable.
- Sets nameplate safety height to 0.4 yalms.
